headline: Cadence advertises SystemVerilog RNM model qualification against schematics and analog assertions
fact: Cadence posted Mixed-Signal Systems and Verification Engineer R55855. The assigned work develops accurate, simulation-efficient SystemVerilog analog/RF behavioral models, verifies them against analog schematics, integrates them with RTL, and checks analog functionality against specifications using testbenches, scenarios and assertions. Qualifications name RNM, UDN/UDT/UDR, wreal, Verilog-AMS and analog assertion-based verification. Modeling and verification results are documented for formal review. This records an engineering hiring mandate rather than a product release or a reported customer deployment.

sources.title: Cadence Careers: Mixed-Signal Systems and Verification Engineer (R55855)
sources.summary: Official Workday startDate is September 25, 2026. Full duties explicitly distinguish model development, schematic-correlation checks, RTL integration, specification checks and formal review.
